A Survey of Finite Structure Enumeration

Abstract

We survey methods for counting finite topological structures and relate them to poset enumeration.

1. Introduction

Counting the topologies on a finite set is equivalent to counting preorders. This survey collects the main approaches.

2. Background

A topology on a finite set corresponds to a preorder.

2.1 Preorders

Every finite topology is an Alexandroff space.

3. Methods

Transfer matrices and direct search are the two dominant families.

4. Conclusions

The enumeration problem remains open beyond small n.

References

  1. P. Alexandroff. Diskrete Räume. Mat. Sbornik, 2:501-519, 1937.
  2. R. Stanley. On the number of open sets of finite topologies. J. Combin. Theory, 10(1):74-79, 1971. doi:10.1016/S0021-9800(71)80011-5
  3. M. Erne. Struktur- und Anzahlformeln fur Topologien auf endlichen Mengen. Manuscripta Math., 11:221-259, 1974.
  4. D. Kleitman and B. Rothschild. The number of finite topologies. Proc. Amer. Math. Soc., 25:276-282, 1970.
